title: discrim-eval: templated approve/deny decisions
description: Anthropic discrim-eval (Tamkin et al. 2023), 70 yes/no decision scenarios across loans, housing, insurance, hiring, medical, with age/gender/race templating. Fits noul yes/no engines directly. Extend with our inserted-clause cues and same-shape floors. Verify licence.

Feature: discrim-eval extends with inserted-clause cues

Scenario: The 70 scenarios score alongside our own cues on the same floors
